_comment: The UniME cluster. See CLUSTER_RUNBOOK.md for how it was set up.
'broker' and 'es' run on vm1. 'producer_node' must share a clock with the
workers, so it is a cluster node and never the laptop (~2.5 s off).
The Pis were unreachable until 2026-10-02, when the Docker bridge on vm1 was
moved off 172.17.0.0/16 - it collided with the Pi subnet.

vm1.note: also hosts Kafka, Elasticsearch and Kibana, so it carries more load than a pure worker

rasp1.note: Raspberry Pi 4 worker; reachable since the docker0 bridge on vm1 was moved off 172.17.0.0/16

rasp2.note: Raspberry Pi 4 worker; reachable since the docker0 bridge on vm1 was moved off 172.17.0.0/16
